The '''Rellekka Rooftop Course''' is a [[Rooftop Agility Course]] located in [[Rellekka]] that is available to players with an [[Agility]] level of 80 or higher. It is preceded by the [[Pollnivneach Rooftop Course]] and followed by the [[Ardougne Rooftop Course]]. 

At level 85 Agility, players stop failing at the first tightrope.

A full lap of this Agility course can be done in 51.0 seconds (85 [[tick]]s), allowing a maximum rate of 55,052.4 experience per hour assuming perfect laps. This rate is increased to a maximum rate of 64,941.2 experience per hour with the completion of the [[hard Fremennik Diary]]. The rate can be increased even further, albeit very slightly (roughly 600 xp/hr), through use of the teleport on [[Fremennik sea boots 4]].

Using this course alone, levelling up from level 80 to 90 would require 4,308 laps, meaning roughly 61 hours of training at the maximum hourly rate.

[[Mark of grace|Marks of grace]] spawn on the Rellekka course at a rate of roughly 1 mark every 3.5 to 4.5 minutes. At maximum efficiency, one can expect 13–15.5 marks per hour.
